reason: The preceding balance attempt passed native protections but failed its layouts17/23 gate by0.000178. That attempt remains rejected. This new campaign explicitly adds those inspected layouts to development and tests robustness across both known batches. Different, prospectively declared layouts decide final validation.
geometries: The previously screened balance001 and002, plus balance001 with north_bearing shifted by-1 or+1 degree. These four proposals are fixed before any new integrations. Hold r39 shared physics, planet, target rules and numerical criteria fixed.
reuse: Reuse only self-generated, numerically verified member climates whose actual parameters match exactly. Freeze their file hashes and original protocols. Combine actual climate arrays equally over all five training layouts; never average only their scores or correct climate fields.
training_gate: Both known batches and the five-layout mean climate must have zonefit no worse than matched r38. Also predict native metrics for layouts1-3 using the measured balance003 ds8-minus-ds16 discrepancy, for ranking only; predicted violations of the unchanged native protections must sum to zero. Rank eligible proposals by five-layout zonefit, then proposal name. At most one advances to actual native verification.
native: On actual ds8 mean climate for layouts1,2,3, require zonefit>=r38+0.001, strict agreement no worse, every zone recall loss<=0.02, Mediterranean dry-share increase<=0.005, Cs-share loss<=0.02, and all observed numerical checks passed.
validation: Only a native-passing proposal takes the five prospective validation layouts at ds16, paired against r38. Require their mean-climate zonefit no worse and strict-agreement loss<=0.01. Record all members. No second candidate or tuning after inspecting these layouts. These layouts are unused by the preceding campaigns; the previously inspected17/23 are explicitly training data now.
publication: Only all gates passing permit a full staged Earth atlas rebuild and food, population, asset and actual .bat-server browser checks. Keep canonical r38 and independently fitted Free/Whittaker climates until a qualified replacement is verified. Preserve every failed preceding campaign.
